description: Source-of-truth catalog of Atlas alert types — the SAME menu a person uses in the app's alert form. READ this (via the List-Alert-Types tool) and create alerts the SAME way a human navigates the form: pick a type whose create_ui is true, then fill its conditions using ONLY the options listed here (the `label` is the exact wording the app shows on the button). For anything about a Greek / dealer exposure — the 'wall' (king node) shifting to a new strike OR the net exposure flipping sides (the 'gamma flip') — the ONLY type is 'Greek exposure move' (king_node); which of the two it watches is conditions.move_mode. There is NO separate 'greek flip' / 'gamma flip' TYPE in the app; never create one. Types with create_ui:false (only `custom`) are EDIT-ONLY — not in the create form, so do NOT create them. Create with the Create-Alert tool, or with Manage-Alerts inside an alert-creator workflow. Periodic exposure metrics sample ~every 5 min; price/flow_rank check every few seconds.

common.symbol: Ticker. Required for every type EXCEPT flow_rank, top_flow and trigger_event.
common.expiration_date: Optional YYYY-MM-DD on greek/exposure types to scope to ONE expiry (e.g. 'SPY GEX flip for 05/06'); omit for the whole chain.
common.active_from_time: Optional HH:MM in US/Eastern — the app's 'Active from' time. Only evaluate at/after this each day (pairs with active_to_time to bound an intraday window).
common.active_to_time: Optional HH:MM in US/Eastern — the app's 'Active until' time. Only evaluate at/before this each day.
common.active_days: Optional days-of-week filter for the active window; 'weekdays' (Mon-Fri) is the common value. Omit to evaluate every day.
common.cooldown_seconds: Min gap between fires per user (floor 30, default 300).
common.fire_on_start: Optional bool — king_node / volume_spike / volume_shift / flow_rank / top_flow only. Fire ONCE at the start of the active window each day (active_from_time), even with NO shift, so an alert bound to a workflow/task gets that first entry at the open. Rides the normal same-day rules (a brand-new alert still needs fire_same_day to fire today). A real shift on the same tick wins over it.
common.notify_discord: The app's 'Send a DM when it fires' toggle (default true). Auto-suppressed if a connected workflow already DMs.
common.notes: Optional free-text note (top-level field, max ~2000 chars). Attach context or a directive for the workflow/task this alert triggers — e.g. 'Only go long if SPY is green on the day.' When the alert fires, the note is FORWARDED to the triggered workflow/task's agent AND shown in the alert DM. Optional; omit for none.
common.fan_out: Identical alerts (same type+symbol+conditions) across many users are evaluated ONCE and the DM is fanned out per subscriber.
common.on_fire: Optional 'When it goes off, also…' actions (any combination): run workflows (workflow_id for one, or workflow_ids:[...] for many), run run-once tasks (task_ids:[...]), re-arm triggers (reactivate_trigger_id for one, or reactivate_trigger_ids:[...] for many), arm a NEW trigger ({"trigger": {symbol, snaptrade_account_id, rule}}), or place a LIVE order ({"order": {symbol, snaptrade_account_id, rule, "live": true}} — double-gated: needs live:true AND the server switch).
common.intraday_only: Optional bool, default false. false = a change that happened while the market was SHUT still counts: the last reading of the previous session is compared against the first of this one, so an overnight/weekend move fires at the open. true = only a change DURING one session counts; the first reading of each ET day just re-arms the alert. Supported on king_node, level_approach, volume_spike, volume_shift, flow_rank, top_flow, price and contract_price. SEPARATE from the contract roll: an alert with no expiration_date pinned follows the FRONT expiry, which rolls daily, and the worker always re-baselines on a roll rather than reporting it as a move — so a roll never fires, whatever this is set to.
common.expiration_range: Optional how far out, on king_node / volume_spike / level_approach (a Greek wall) and flow: '0dte' (the nearest expiry; the default on exposure types), '1w', '1m', '3m', '6m' (exposure is summed across every expiry in the window; on flow it keeps only trades on contracts expiring inside it), or 'any' (flow only, the default: no filter). Set this OR expiration_date, never both.

alert_types.label: Options flow
alert_types.description: Options flow — alerts you when a big options trade hits the tape for your ticker; you set the minimum premium/size and other filters. Fires on an options-flow trade matching the filter.

alert_types.label: Greek exposure move
alert_types.description: Greek exposure move — THE Greek / dealer-exposure alert (there is no separate 'greek flip' or 'gamma flip' TYPE; the flip lives here as conditions.move_mode). Pick which Greek to watch (metric: gamma=GEX, delta=DEX, vanna=VEX, theta=TEX); metric may be comma-separated for multi (AND: fires once EVERY listed Greek has produced its move). conditions.move_mode picks WHAT counts as a move: 'node' (default) = the strike with the most dealer exposure (the king node / 'wall') RELOCATES to a NEW price — any move, either direction, no deadband; 'flip_positive' / 'flip_negative' / 'flip' = the Greek's NET exposure crosses zero into positive / into negative / either way (this is the classic 'gamma flip'); 'any' = a node move OR an either-way flip, whichever lands first. A flip mode never fires off the starting state — it needs a real crossing between two readings. Optionally pin expiration_date to one expiry; blank tracks the front/0DTE expiry, which rolls daily. The chart marks BOTH walls at once — purple for the biggest positive net exposure, yellow for the biggest negative — and node_positive / node_negative let an alert follow either one on its own.

conditions.move_mode: node|node_positive|node_negative|flip_positive|flip_negative|flip|any (optional, default 'node'). node = the WALL (king node — the strike with the most dealer exposure in ABSOLUTE terms) moves to a new strike. node_positive / node_negative = ONE side's wall moves to a new strike: the biggest +net-exposure strike (drawn purple on the chart) or the biggest -net-exposure strike (drawn yellow). flip_negative / flip_positive / flip = PRICE crosses the Greek's FLIP LEVEL. Going up the strikes, a flip level is a strike whose net exposure has the opposite sign to the strike below it; price at or above a strike is in that strike's regime. flip_positive = price crossed up into a positive strike after a negative one (e.g. 89 negative, 90 positive: fires once price is above 90); flip_negative = the reverse; flip = either way. Fires only when PRICE crosses a level on the current ladder, never when a strike changes sign under a stationary price. NOT the whole chain's sum changing sign; any = a wall move OR an either-way flip.
conditions.expiration_date: YYYY-MM-DD (optional — pin one expiry, else the front/0DTE expiry that rolls daily)

alert_types.label: Volume spike
alert_types.description: Volume spike — alerts you when a ticker's total daily option volume jumps by the percent you set (threshold_pct). Optionally pin the check to one contract via expiration_date + strike.

conditions.expiration_date: YYYY-MM-DD (optional — pin the volume check to one contract's expiry)
conditions.strike: number (optional — pin to one strike; with expiration_date, checks that one contract every ~30 min)

alert_types.label: Top-volume contract rotation
alert_types.description: Top-volume contract rotation — alerts you when a different option contract becomes the most-traded one (#1 by daily volume) for your ticker.

alert_types.label: New top flow (no ticker)
alert_types.description: New top flow — alerts you when a new trade or ticker breaks into the top of the whole market's options flow (incl. outside the standing universe). No ticker needed. top_n sets the cutoff.

alert_types.label: Price level cross
alert_types.description: Price level cross — alerts you when the stock price crosses a level you set: above, below, or either way. (direction 'cross' is the app's 'Either way'.)

alert_types.label: Contract price cross
alert_types.description: Contract price cross — alerts you when ONE specific option contract's price crosses a level you set. Pick the strike, expiry, and call/put. (direction 'cross' is the app's 'Either way'.)

alert_types.label: Price near greeks
alert_types.description: Price near greeks — watches the stock price against a level you pick: a Greek wall (conditions.metric = that Greek's king-node strike, dynamic) or a static conditions.level. conditions.region_mode picks WHAT fires: 'near' (default) = spot gets CLOSE to the level, band = within_pct (default 0.5) or within_points; 'flip_positive' / 'flip_negative' / 'flip' = spot CROSSES the level, changing which side of it the price sits on (ABOVE the level is the positive side, BELOW it the negative side) — into positive / into negative / either way. A flip is ARMED FROM THE ORIGIN SIDE: the first reading only records which side spot is on, so a 'positive → negative' alert set while spot is ALREADY below the level waits for spot to go above it and then cross back down. within_pct / within_points are ignored in the flip modes.

conditions.region_mode: near|flip_positive|flip_negative|flip (optional, default 'near'). near = spot entered the proximity band. flip_negative = spot crossed the level DOWNWARD; flip_positive = crossed UPWARD; flip = either way. Armed from the origin side, so it never fires off the starting state. THIS IS PRICE, NOT EXPOSURE: the mode names are 'positive'/'negative' because above the level is called the positive side, and a user asking for a 'gamma flip' / 'GEX flip' (the Greek's own net exposure crossing zero) wants alert_type king_node with move_mode, NOT this. Never name an alert of this type a flip.

alert_types.label: Top 20 flow
alert_types.description: Top 20 flow — alerts you when a ticker enters or drops out of the market's top-20 options-flow leaderboard by premium. No ticker needed.

alert_types.label: Options ratio
alert_types.description: Options ratio: who leads, calls or puts, and by how much. Open interest (contracts held) is checked once a day at 09:35 ET; unusual flow (the day's flow board: the largest block and sweep prints, the same ones top flow shows; bullish = calls bought to open + puts sold to open, less calls sold to close + puts bought to close; bearish the mirror; by premium) is checked on the hour from 10:30 ET (a busy name's flow can take a few minutes to read; a read that runs long is simply tried again at the next check). The lead is always the bigger side over the smaller in x ("Puts lead 2.30x"); there is no 'even'. Fires when the leader FLIPS, or when a side LEADS by at least lead_x. The DM shows the working: what was measured, both sides' numbers and the division.

conditions.ratio_trigger: 'flip' (default): the leader changes (calls ↔ puts, bullish ↔ bearish; the first reading only sets the baseline). 'lead': a side leads by at least lead_x (fires on the crossing, re-arms after dropping back below).
conditions.lead_side: For 'lead': 'calls' | 'puts' | 'either' on open_interest; 'bullish' | 'bearish' | 'either' on unusual_flow. Default 'either'.
conditions.lead_x: For 'lead': the minimum lead, bigger side over smaller, e.g. 2 for '2x or more'. At least 1.
conditions.min_dte: Optional fewest days to expiry to include (0 = today).
conditions.max_dte: Optional most days to expiry to include. With neither, open interest uses the next 5 expirations and flow uses every expiry.
conditions.strikes_around_spot: Open interest: listed strikes each side of spot (default 50; 0 = every strike).
conditions.min_premium: Unusual flow: only prints of at least this premium in dollars.
conditions.min_tag: Unusual flow: only prints at least this unusual by volume/OI: unusual, very_unusual, extreme_unusual.

example.name: SPY puts lead 2x on open interest

alert_types.label: Technicals
alert_types.description: Technicals — alerts you when one indicator crosses another (e.g. price crosses the 20 EMA, or the 9 EMA crosses VWAP). Pick the watch and target indicators, the direction, and the timeframe.

alert_types.label: My trigger acts
alert_types.description: My trigger acts — alerts you when one of your OWN trading triggers acts: it places/exits a trade, is paused, or is deleted. No ticker needed. Pick which events to watch; optionally scope to a single trigger, one source workflow/task, one signal group (any trigger a play from that group placed), and/or one broker account.

conditions.events: one or more of: placed | exited | paused | deleted
conditions.trigger_id: optional: only this trigger id (omit = any of your triggers)
conditions.source_workflow_id: optional: only triggers created by this workflow or task id. Omit for any. "none" = only triggers no workflow or task created (your own, or a play's)
conditions.signal_group_id: optional: only triggers that came from this signal group id — any play posted to or taken from that group. Omit for any. "none" = only triggers that did NOT come from a signal group
conditions.snaptrade_account_id: optional: only triggers trading through this broker account (omit = any broker)

alert_types.label: Custom / placeholder (edit-only)
alert_types.description: EDIT-ONLY — reserved for bespoke conditions; not offered in the create form and not auto-evaluated.
